__comment: Firefox overrides, merged over manifest.json by package.sh.
Firefox has no background service worker support and needs background.scripts;
Chrome warns that background.scripts requires manifest v2 or lower. Shipping one
manifest to both therefore always warns somewhere, so each browser gets its own.
Keys set to null here are removed from the Firefox manifest.
data_collection_permissions has been required by AMO since 2025-11-03; once an
extension starts declaring it, every later version must keep declaring it.
